review.title: Missing structured sessions
review.detail: No time, location, interaction, combat, segment, entity or watch JSON exists for these sessions. Do not bridge these gaps with narrative or session-note content. Later checkpoints resume independently; the missing adventures are not reconstructed.

review.title: Campaign opening month
review.detail: March 22, 1748 is the user-authorized campaign anchor. S1 yamlCheck records tentative “maybe mid-April” weather commentary; retain the anchor and review the tentative month wording.

review.title: Fort arrival moves backward within the day
review.detail: S2 t10 dates the injured-hyena stop before the fort to lunchtime; S3 t01 calls the subsequent campsite investigation before noon. The calendar date stays March 25; watches at this handoff are disputed.

review.title: Bas Udda date drift propagates into the Kharsan expedition
review.detail: S19 explicitly reaches Bas Udda April 28 and departs April 29. Its second-travel-day stone house arrival is April 30 or May 1, not YAML May 2. Carry both alternatives through S20–25 rather than resetting at each session. S26 explicitly dates the return approach May 23; the compressed return journey allows that checkpoint. Review S19 t12/t19 and downstream YAML dates together.

review.title: Ambush clock reverses
review.detail: The ambush is about 03:00, but its aftermath is described as just past midnight. Keep April 10 and flag dawn versus midnight rather than assigning two separate fights.

review.title: Monastery approach watch reverses
review.detail: S21 ends around 16:00 at the lookout, while S22 reopens at midday and reaches the monastery about 14:00. Same date and continuous approach; do not silently reorder the events or add a day.

review.title: External calendar precision removed
review.detail: Discarded note-only dates: S32 June 15 mirror evening; S45 August 1 diamond; S58 exact August 25 scenes; S69 September 14/22 mirror examinations; S95 exact May 3 pre-dawn visitor; S100 morning; S106 afternoon landing. Date bounds or transcript-supported watches replace them. These are evidence limitations, not requests to consult session notes.

review.title: Conflicting local clocks
review.detail: S40 Kiran approach is midafternoon but departure midday. S44 theft is approximately 22:00–23:00 approaching midnight. S47 sailing is described at sunset before a later 15:00 anchor. Preserve the reported clocks in evidence and leave affected watches disputed.

review.title: Played Sendings precede YAML start
review.detail: The first Sending is about a week before the second; the second is the night before August 8 arrival. Include these retrospectively played events before S46’s August 8 YAML start, without duplicating the journey.

review.title: August 6 contradicts the ongoing September chronology
review.detail: S51 independently reaches September 4 and then September 5. S52 later says August 6. The working branch continues into a compatible September 6 ambush checkpoint and September 7 predawn sequence, while preserving August 6 as a competing spoken date. S52’s lair journey has both a three-day summary and a third-day camp followed by next-day arrival. No postbattle return/recovery through September 30 is recorded. The September 30 dispersal is a later compatible checkpoint with missing intervening coverage, not a narrated 24-day interval.

review.title: Dark Fire is October 8 on the supported projection
review.detail: October 6 camp plus two overnight transitions reaches October 8, not YAML October 9. S55 awards a rest and describes a day-and-night walk. Its exact rest boundary and later unmeasured leg remain open; October 14 return can be compatible but does not establish the intermediate itinerary.

review.title: Wellby reaches the islands October 11
